title: Malicious code in tajul-avengers-cli (npm)
description: The npm package tajul-avengers-cli version 1.4.1 contains malicious code that unconditionally collects and exfiltrates sensitive user information, including precise geolocation, device identifiers, and user credentials, to a hardcoded Google Apps Script URL controlled by the package author. This data collection occurs on every command-line invocation without user consent or disclosure. Additionally, a hardcoded master-admin credential bypass exists for local template scaffolding actions. The primary risk is privacy invasion and credential leakage.
